theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: The only high-ranking theme with a scorable proxy (515000.SS) that also has clean eligibility. Its durability bar is middling (0.46, mixed hurst) and breadth is poor (0.118), so this is a fragile, low-conviction lean on the CHALLENGER sustaining relative strength rather than a leadership call. Momentum rank-IC is ~0 per the backtest, so I am NOT reading rank 2 as a return forecast — only as evidence that flow is concentrating here enough to watch for continuation.
evidence: challenger to Gold Miners with margin 0.285
theses.dissent: Breadth of 0.118 means the rally inside AI Compute is one or two names, not the theme; a single name rolling over could pull the whole proxy down while the rank looks fine. The mixed hurst tag also means it is not in a clean trend.

falsifier.text: 515000.SS underperforms the CSI 300 by 3% or more before 2026-09-15 while Gold Miners remain the leader

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: The only non-commodity-adjacent theme with a scorable proxy and clean trend characteristics: durability_bar 0.77, hurst 'trend', breadth 0.769 (broad participation), not crowded (crowding_z -0.2). This is a genuine trend-following lean on a broad theme, but the trend gate did NOT hold on this market historically, so it is expressed as a low-conviction continuation hypothesis rather than a drawdown-protected allocation.
theses.dissent: The backtest shows the absolute-trend gate whipsaws on China A-shares (mean-reverting tape). A broad trend-tagged theme can still mean-revert sharply, and Industrial Metals is highly correlated to the macro cycle which is being dominated by ai_tech and geopolitics narratives (unscheduled share 0.91 means surprise risk is high).

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Rank 7 with a 'mean-revert' hurst_tag despite a breadth of 1.0 and durability 0.66. The mean-revert tag combined with gate_helps=false (trend discipline does not hold here) makes this a low-conviction AVOID: a mean-reverting theme on a mean-reverting market tape is the worst combination for a trend-following lean. This is not a short — just no directional case.
theses.dissent: Coal has breadth 1.0 and durability 0.66 — the entire theme is participating, and dividend-yield coal names often hold up in China's defensive tape. Calling it avoid could miss a mean-reversion bounce if the tape flips.
